advice: Treat ACP as a sixth capability surface (MCP, MCP App, WebMCP, HTTP, ACP, website) — carts, feeds, orders, auth, MCP integration, negotiation, payment handlers, discounts.
detail: April 2026 protocol snapshot. No implementation until a vertical needs checkout (domains barred as digital goods; print physical later). Direction only for now.

advice: Build new templates on MCP SDK v2 split packages; do not copy 2025 monolith tutorials.
detail: Current layout: @modelcontextprotocol/client|server|node|express|ext-apps. Our server imports already use split paths (server/mcp.js); verify on every SDK bump.

advice: Use agentcom.org/<capability> pages, mcp.agentcom.org subdomains for infra, and brutally literal capability titles — no branded .com per tool.
detail: Shape: agentcom.org/domain-availability (page), mcp.agentcom.org/domain-availability (infra), agentcom.org/tools/<x> (widget home). Separate exact-match domains only with independent acquisition value (domainavailability.com, llmprices.com). Reflected in apps/mcp manifest page fields.

advice: Parent on agentcom.org; .com for consumer transactional, .dev for dev tools, any reputable TLD for backends, .xyz fine for experiments.
detail: No OpenAI protocol/ranking preference for .com found; MCP spec treats domain as host/security-origin concern. Strengthens tld-guidance-xyz with the full hierarchy.

advice: Design purchases as discovery-in-chat plus merchant-owned checkout with redirectUrl return — not native in-chat payment.
detail: March 2026 shift: emphasis to product discovery + merchants' own checkout; users pay via card on file or entered in ChatGPT checkout UI (never raw PAN in chat); merchant of record stays merchant. Domains additionally barred from plugin commerce (digital goods) — lookup in chat, transact on site.

advice: Register the same 1–3 capability tools via WebMCP on agentcom.org pages — third transport beside MCP server and ChatGPT app, same metadata.
detail: Starter in apps/web/src/webmcp.ts (feature-detect both attachment points, guarded no-op in Node). Caveats: origin-trial status, invisible to extension content scripts, ~no agent traffic yet — experiment lane. Verify registration on a schedule like a payment webhook; guard the load before the call.

advice: Host each app on its own subdomain root (checker.agentcom.org), never a path, and prefer subdomains over separate domains.
detail: Casey: non-root .well-known verification will never be supported (RFC-8615) — paths are out. Parent-origin challenge covers subdomains; one verified AgentCom identity, shared privacy/ToS/support pages, compounding reputation, lower cost. Separate .dev domains per app add fragmentation with zero evidenced review benefit. Register the parent NOW: new domains face ~30 days heightened scrutiny in any TLD.

advice: Host apps on high-trust TLDs (.org/.com/.dev); use .xyz freely inside suggestion inventory but never as our own trust surface.
detail: No OpenAI TLD rule exists. Evidence: browsers/SSL/search treat .xyz equally, but perceived trust lags, corporate filters stay cautious, and abuse concentration is high (.xyz +103% regs; 47k listed in latest snapshot). TLD is a context clue, not a verdict — but our host domain is chosen once, so choose boring trust.

advice: Optimize descriptions for information density: specific enough to select, compact enough not to bloat context — test both failure directions.
detail: 545-site WebMCP study: vagueness and verbosity are opposite ends of one spectrum. Implemented as no-marketing + sibling-overlap gates + hill-climb length variants in packages/evals. Quality = intent specificity + differentiating constraints + argument semantics − prose − marketing − sibling overlap.

advice: Set ui.domain deliberately — on ChatGPT the app-name click can lead there, so it is acquisition surface, not just sandbox origin.
detail: Cross-host builder finding (ext-apps discussion #557). Lint metadata for correctness AND commercial consequence; never leave domain unset or pointed at a placeholder.

advice: Ship manifest + llms.txt + JSON-LD with every capability from day one — MCP Apps are invisible to ordinary web discovery.
detail: Implemented: /.well-known/agentcom.json, /llms.txt, /capability.jsonld served by apps/mcp with HTTP tests. JSON-LD proposal (ext-apps discussion #606) may never standardize; the cost is near zero anyway.

advice: Design transaction tools for the return leg: approved redirect domains skip the interstitial and route the user back into the originating conversation.
detail: ext-apps issue #678. Our checkout handoff must request the round trip, not an outbound link — affects place_print_order's successor and all future book_* tools.

advice: Never emit one universal resource metadata object — adapt per negotiated host capabilities.
detail: Datadog cross-host catalog: vendor field for one host breaks another, ui.domain formats differ, app-only visibility inconsistent, insets differ. Capability → detector → per-host adapter (ChatGPT/Claude/Cursor/VSCode/generic).

advice: Track (don't duplicate) the official MCP App validator proposal — conformance commoditizes upstream, our moat is compat + evals + telemetry.
detail: ext-apps issue #673 (open): 'no canonical way to check conformance'. Verified open via API. Consume it when it lands; keep our gate focused on layers 2–7.

advice: Directory search matches app name + 30-char subtitle only — put the query's keywords there, not in the long description.
detail: Casey Chow (Apps platform team): searching long descriptions was 'more noisy and less helpful', so name/subtitle-only is intentional current behavior. OP confirmed 'education' in long descriptions stopped surfacing. Implication: long description is for humans post-click, not retrieval.

advice: Name each app as the literal user query (Domain Checker, Find a Tradesperson) under the AgentCom developer identity — clever brands don't retrieve.
detail: Follows directly from name/subtitle-only search. Revisit only if description search returns or developer-reputation ranking is confirmed.

advice: Do not model any revenue on contextual auto-discovery volume — a compliant, performant app saw ~50 users/day against ~5M matching weekly queries, decaying to 1–2/day.
detail: georg-san's numbers; Jonathan_Labs reports zero traffic; multiple devs corroborate static category pages showing top brands only. Auto-suggest was announced but devs question whether it runs at all. Distribution must come from elsewhere (direct links, web, existing channels) until proven otherwise.

advice: Treat directory placement as editorial/manual, not algorithmic — categories are static and brand-weighted.
detail: Casey: 'directory listings right now are fairly manual… experimenting with fair surfacing'; devs report unchanging static pages. Community's top asks: user ratings, usage-based ranking. None shipped as of latest crawl.

advice: App directory landing pages are client-rendered with no indexable title/meta — don't spend backlink effort on them; host your own indexable landing pages.
detail: AldiPower: crawlers see no useful HTML, external backlinks wasted. Build agentcom.org vertical pages as the SEO surface and deep-link into the directory.

advice: Hill-climb tool metadata against measured tool-selection evals: clear intent + model-written descriptions + lots of evals is the entire known playbook.
detail: Casey Chow verbatim: 'Making the suggested intent of the tool clear to the model, leaning on model-written language for tool descriptions (models are generally fairly good at writing for themselves), and writing lots of evals + hill-climbing on them.' Best practices 'extremely in flux'; docs deliberately vague. This is the closest thing to an official discovery guide.

advice: Architect GUI-on-top-of-MCP (resources = UI, tools = actions) so the capability stays portable to Codex, Claude, Gemini and raw MCP clients.
detail: Experienced builder framing; matches our core/surfaces split. Don't build an OpenAI-specific React monolith — the market graph is the moat, hosts are interchangeable.

advice: Verify invocation on Free accounts, not just Plus — a May 2026 regression left Free accounts unable to invoke any apps.
detail: Reported with screenshots across all apps. Add Free-tier invocation to the pre-submission checklist and re-verify after approval.

advice: Test all six layers independently (protocol, host compat, routing, execution, UI, discovery) plus observability — most builders test one or two.
detail: Division of labor observed: spec-check shape → protocol+observability, MCPJam contract → routing+execution, probe apps → host quirks, Skybridge shape → compat, xmcp checklist → submission, forum history → review reality, ext-apps contributors → future spec. Our gate + evals + intel mirror this split.

advice: Point enterprise prospects at X's machine surface (hosted MCP at api.x.com/mcp + docs MCP + OpenAPI + llms.txt + skill.md) as proof the machine-callable thesis is mainstream.
detail: X exposes 200+ endpoints via Streamable HTTP MCP plus full agent-consumable docs. Validates 'companies expose themselves in machine-callable form'; our gap is the long tail that won't do it uniformly.
